title: EnvDeck profile
description: A named set of Windows environment variable changes that can be turned on and off.

group.description: Profiles in the same group are mutually exclusive: turning one on turns the others off (e.g. "java").

value.description: %VAR% references are kept and expanded by Windows (REG_EXPAND_SZ). For Prepend/Append: ';'-separated entries.

scope.description: User = HKCU (no admin). Machine = HKLM (needs admin). Note: Windows puts the Machine Path before the User Path.

op.description: Set: overwrite. Remove: delete. Prepend/Append: add entries to a list variable such as Path.

kind.description: Registry type. Omit for automatic (ExpandString when the value contains %VAR%).
